name: CamCheck ChArUco A4 10x7
legacy_pattern_note: squares_y is odd: the OpenCV >= 4.6 and legacy layouts are identical (top-left square black)
corner_object_point_mm: id -> x = ((id % 9) + 1) * 27.685999999999996, y = (floor(id / 9) + 1) * 27.685999999999996, z = 0; origin = outer top-left corner of the board, x right, y down

page.sheet_contents: board only - no printed text and no scale bar; this board leaves 8.0 / 8.1 mm above and below it, inside the unprintable margin of a normal printer. The wording is on print-charuco-a4.html and in the PDF Title / Subject.
